summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time with capture/clear logic in Progress update/advance/reset, the progress.elapsed default style, Palette.__rich__, tests (test_time_elapsed_column, test_columns column-list and expected-output update, tests/test_palette.py test_rich_cast), and a CHANGELOG Unreleased section. Nothing was run and nothing was committed: test_columns' expected output was derived by hand-tracing the clock reads (MockClock returns its read index), with bar widths 33→25 and 23→16 and elapsed values 0:00:37/0:00:36 at start and 0:01:00/0:00:45 frozen at completion. The new and updated tests are unverified until someone runs them.
